paper.title: Skills-Coach: A Self-Evolving Skill Optimizer via Training-Free GRPO
paper.central_claim: Skills-Coach以Training-Free GRPO联合优化skill说明和代码，自动生成边界任务并可追踪执行评价，在48技能Skill-X上大幅提升泛化、鲁棒性和效率。

provenance.notes: 派发 model type=sonnet，声明映射 gpt-6.1-sol；未独立探测模型，工具未提供可核验 actual_model/session/receipt，故为 null。未读另一席或其他 attempt；未运行收录代码。

sections_read: Abstract; §§1–2.5 all four modules including virtual/real modes
§§3.1–3.4 all settings, Tables1–2 and Figures1/3/4 captions
§4 Conclusion; Appendix A all51 criteria Table3; Appendix B all48 skill sources

reason: 完整材料评价非权重skill文本/代码的训练任务反馈留存，属于范围内；评价效度/协议不足按原稿事实计分。
rationale: 有训练/测试划分和优化前后技能比较，但GRPO实际描述接近best-of-3；规则/LLM混合rubric偏文档形式，无搜索/修复消融、judge校验或实际成本，泛化与效率结论仅局部支持。

evidence.quote: it estimates task completion by verifying the presence of evaluation-criteria-related keywords (such as "error handling" and "save") within the skill instruction, combined with deterministic random numbers generated from a hash of the skill’s content.
evidence.support_explanation: virtual模式非真实执行；不能不加区分当功能效度。

evidence.quote: tasks within the test set maintain a difficulty level commensurate with the training set but feature entirely distinct contexts
evidence.support_explanation: 声明同难度不同context，缺实例/重叠审计。

evidence.quote: the system generates multiple instruction variants, scores them comparatively, and selects the highest-performing variant as the baseline for subsequent iterations
evidence.support_explanation: 清楚的群组候选选择，没有GRPO数学目标/advantages定义。

evidence.quote: an auto-fixer that remediates specific issues—such as dependency conflicts, parameter misconfigurations, and path errors—based on failure case analyses
evidence.support_explanation: 失败→代码修复，未给defect/lapse区分。

evidence.quote: provisions an independent temporary workspace for each test task, duplicates its environment, executes commands, and captures standard outputs, errors, return codes, and generated files.
evidence.support_explanation: 真实模式收集外部产物与错误，有重建基础。

evidence.quote: Execution defaults to real mode for both optimization-time execution and final evaluation.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者声明默认real，不能指控主结果必定virtual。

evidence.quote: the current pipeline creates 12 training tasks and 8 test tasks, with an even split between difficulty levels (6 standard + 6 advanced for training, 4 standard + 4 advanced for testing).
evidence.support_explanation: 每skill小样本训练/测试与难度分层。

evidence.quote: During Training-Free GRPO optimization, each epoch generates 3 rollout variants (group_size=3) for the current skill version and evaluates them on the training set, rather than generating variants per individual task.
evidence.support_explanation: 3 epochs x3 variants，以训练题选择，非每题9新policy。

evidence.quote: After execution and failure analysis, the Auto-Fix loop supports up to 2 iterative fix-test-reanalyze rounds (max_iterations=2).
evidence.support_explanation: fix-test具体是否训练或final test未足够说明。

evidence.quote: the default model is claude-sonnet-4-6 (with heuristic fallbacks when API-based generation is unavailable).
evidence.support_explanation: 模型默认但无每试验fallback使用/失败情况披露。

evidence.quote: For instruction-only skills, LLMs are employed to conduct in-depth evaluations across eight dimensions: structural integrity, practicality, example quality, technical depth, clarity, command coverage, error handling, and advanced scenario adaptability.
evidence.support_explanation: 29说明类技能评价含文档形式而非独立任务正确率。

evidence.quote: Correct use of 2+ professional technical terms (API, CLI, SDK, etc.)
evidence.support_explanation: 可由表面术语满足，不直接代表能力；不作为holdout重复惩罚。

evidence.quote: the pass rate dramatically improves from 33.59% to 88.02%
evidence.support_explanation: 作者报告+54.43个百分点，不是复现。

evidence.quote: five skills maintained perfect scores of 1.0 and 100% pass rates both before and after optimization
evidence.support_explanation: 无改进样例有报告，但无重复运行方差。

evidence.quote: the module accelerates training time from hours to minutes, reduces data requirements from thousands of samples to merely dozens
evidence.support_explanation: 效率为概括宣称，无实测成本/基线表支持。

evidence.quote: a task is deemed "passed" if its score meets or exceeds a predefined threshold (defaulting to 70% of the maximum possible score).
evidence.support_explanation: pass系规则得分阈值，不等于100%功能成功。

signatures.operation: 生成3variants→训练集比较评分→留最高版→3epochs重复
signatures.conditions: 小样本代表真实能力、评分器不偏文档表面
signatures.selection_rule/data: 每epoch按12训练题选最佳；8context不同test用于报告
signatures.persistence: 最佳版本供后epoch和最终测试
signatures.later_use: test任务加载优化skill；无跨harness/真实用户长期证据
signatures.claimed_effect: 边界扩展、泛化能力提升

signatures.information: 规范、stdout/stderr、返回码、文件产物及失败分析
signatures.operation: 规则优化→LLM command优化→最多2次fix/test/reanalyze→重新评分
signatures.persistence: 优化skill代码与结果报告；版本/rollback未详
signatures.claimed_effect: 错误处理、鲁棒性及功能扩展
signatures.failure_boundary: auto-fix在哪个split运行欠明确；无修改级回归保护

gap.author_gap: 众包skill数量多但覆盖碎片化，缺自动边界探索与持续改写/评价。
gap.checked_gap: skills文档/代码不完整是真问题，自动prompt/代码修复已存在；本文未独立比较Training-Free GRPO与TextGrad/ProTeGi或简单best-of-N，碎片化到真实复合能力残差不明。
gap.closest_adjacent: 已有文本梯度/候选选择与失败代码修复，本文skill包装、任务生成和可追踪评价整合。
gap.residue: 是否边界任务/差异化策略/相对群组比简单重写更有效，未有消融。
gap.stakes: 真实技能覆盖与维护成本，不只是文档分数
gap.method_response: 从规范造训练/测试，再更新文本与代码并在相同条件比较。
gap.remaining_gap: 边界“扩展”未与真实用户任务或外部真值绑定；效率无成本证据。
unresolved: 请总控共同固定Training-Free GRPO及TextGrad/ProTeGi最近邻原文核对新机制残差；不单席联网。

expectations.applies_when: 多候选搜索宣称方法优势
expectations.reason: 有训练/测试和bestvariant规则，无random/one-shot/simple rewrite、单路径消融，GRPO相对优势未测。
对失败直接修复，未分代码缺陷、执行失误或外部服务故障，缺保留正确行为门。

expectations.applies_when: 评价skill能力而非文字形式
expectations.reason: 主文默认real；virtual/fallback内容清楚，但没逐trial/skill标注实际模式、外部正确率或judge一致性。
12/8不同contexts是隔离声明；无样本/重叠审计，Auto-Fix的fix-test split欠明确。
hours→minutes及数据量优势无计时/费用对照、失败重试总成本。

claims.text: 优化技能在Skill-X上平均分和pass rate显著提升
claims.baseline/control: 原版skill，不是另一等预算优化器
claims.selection_vs_test: 3epochs×3候选在12train题选择；8不同context test，fix-test权限未明
claims.result/denominator: 表1平均0.378→0.84，pass33.59%→88.02%；48skill并列含5无改善；未给所有逐题日志
counterevidence: 51criteria含文档keywords/形式；真实语义成功率与fallback未逐项核验；无置信区间
claims.allowed_conclusion: 作者在自建相邻合成题/规则上报告优化版优于原版，有限retained proxy收益，不等于综合真实能力扩展。

claims.text: Training-Free GRPO比常规优化效率更强且具有跨域泛化
claims.baseline/control: 无GRPO vs best-of-N/one-shot/修复单独/其他optimizer对照
claims.selection_vs_test: 每技能独立优化，不是跨skill冻结迁移实验
claims.result/denominator: hours→minutes仅概括，无调用数/运行时/实际费用表
counterevidence: 群组仅bestvariant描述，缺相对advantage或policy update定义；跨域都是另训技能
claims.allowed_conclusion: 可称无权重候选选择与修复流水线，不能证效率优越、GRPO特有贡献或改进器进步。

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: 按作者real默认与train/test协议，留存优化skill在后续合成test的既定proxy评分高于原版；仅此狭义retained，不认证真实功能、跨域transfer或improver。
unresolved: 实际模式/fallback比例、split和Auto-Fix权限；外部任务judge效度
无等预算优化器/路径消融、方差和实际总成本

G.reason: 技能覆盖问题具体，但对已有prompt/code optimizer的最近邻剩余缺口未查证。

M.reason: 任务反馈→候选/修复→留存链具体；群组最优选择与GRPO名称的对应和泛化假设薄弱。

X.reason: 分组、epochs、workspaces、fix上限与默认real可重建；精确acceptance公式、rollback和split权限欠详。

E.measurement.reason: 指标明确但51criteria混合文档形式/关键词和真实执行；无judge语义效度或模式使用审计，实质能力可被proxy满足。

E.causality.reason: 原版vs优化版支持整个edit链相关收益，未隔离GRPO/规则/fixer或简单同预算重写替代。

E.holdout.reason: 声明12train/8test不同context且选择用train，缺题目/重叠审计与auto-fix权限，未达独立领域迁移。

E.statistics.reason: 48skill分组及无改善边界给出，但每skill8题，缺种子、区间与跨search方差，A2仅1。

E.cost.reason: 仅配置预算和hours/minutes口号；无实际训练/候选/修复/评估token、调用、计时、失败成本。
search_scope: 全文§§1–4、Tables1–3、AppendicesA–B及图注；未报告optimizer实际总成本或等预算效率比较
